N-3.1-A.skill: apply the chain rule to nested compositions of unspecified functions, evaluating each derivative at the correct input from a table.

N-3.1-B.skill: interpret the chain rule as a rate of change of a composite quantity, tracking sign and units.

N-3.2-A.skill: locate points of horizontal tangency on an implicitly defined curve by setting the numerator of dy/dx to zero and substituting into the curve.

N-3.2-B.skill: build the tangent line to an implicit curve at a point and use it to find an intercept.

N-3.3-A.skill: differentiate a composition or product involving an inverse function, using table values of f only.

N-3.3-B.skill: find the second derivative of an inverse function, differentiating 1/f′(x) again with respect to y.

N-3.4-A.skill: differentiate an inverse trigonometric function of a reciprocal or quadratic on a restricted domain, keeping the correct sign.

N-3.4-B.skill: find the rate of change of an angle defined by an inverse trigonometric function of a changing length, with the correct units.

N-3.5-A.skill: recognize that a variable base with a variable exponent needs logarithmic differentiation, and apply it with the product rule.

N-3.5-B.skill: combine product, quotient, power and chain rules with tabulated values of unspecified functions, evaluating each derivative at the correct input.

N-3.6-A.skill: find a second derivative of a reciprocal, root, logarithm or product of an unspecified function from its first and second derivative values.

N-3.6-B.skill: decide the concavity of a composite function from the signs of f′, f″, g′ and g″ using h″ = f″(g)(g′)² + f′(g)g″.
